subject: Use when reasoning about types as a quality property of code: what guarantees the type system actually provides, the…

evals.prompt: Define type-safety in 2-3 sentences. Include the work it owns and the kind of user request that should activate it.
Explain why an agent would need the type-safety skill instead of relying on generic reasoning. Name the failure it prevents.
Describe the mental model or main primitives behind type-safety. Keep it operational rather than just naming the topic.
A user asks: "implement HMAC verification for an inbound webhook (use webhook-integration)". Should type-safety activate? Explain the boundary and name the better owner when possible.
evals.negative_expectation: Must not force type-safety onto a request it explicitly excludes or that belongs to data-modeling, api-design, testing-strategy, code-review, prompt-injection-defense, client-server-boundary.

evals.prompt: A user asks: "review whether this discriminated union has an exhaustiveness check at the switch". Show the first concrete steps an agent should take when applying type-safety.

Place type-safety among its adjacent skills (data-modeling, api-design, testing-strategy, code-review, prompt-injection-defense, client-server-boundary). What does it own, and what does it verify with or defer to?
evals.negative_expectation: Must not collapse related skills into interchangeable names; ownership must be mechanism-level.

evals.prompt: Name one plausible misconception about type-safety and correct it with a mechanism-level explanation.
